$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor autocompletion. Ignored by Portweave at runtime.

services.description: Map of kebab-case service name to its port/env configuration. At least one entry is required.

envVar.description: Environment variable name the allocated port is exposed as. Must be unique across all services.

group.description: Group label. Services that share a group are allocated as a contiguous block so they move together.

preferred.description: Advisory preferred port. v0 allocates from the machine-wide pool regardless.

discoveryEnv.description: Additional environment variables mapped to derived values. Templates use ${serviceName} to interpolate that service's allocated port.
